notes.text: CSV files for finance use ';' as the delimiter and snake_case headers (invoice_id, customer, issued_on, total_cents). Finance opens them in Excel with a French locale. monthly.js predates this; don't copy its format.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: Machine-readable exports carry amounts as integer cents (total_cents: 123450), never formatMoney strings. formatMoney is for the UI only; this was corrected in review twice.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Dates in exports go through toISODate (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). formatDate depends on the server's locale and time zone and is for the UI only.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: New modules use named exports only. The default exports in older files like this one are legacy and are being removed.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: invoicesInMonth filters on UTC month. A local-time filter double-counts invoices issued near midnight at month boundaries; keep getUTCMonth.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: toCents uses Math.round on a float, so '0.285' becomes 28 instead of 29. Known, low impact; fix planned with the decimal library migration.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: formatMoney stays en-US for now; the localisation work (ticket LL-212) will pass the user's locale from the session.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Routes are matched as exact strings: no trailing-slash or query-string handling. /exports/invoices.json?x=1 returns 404.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: To add a route, add a 'METHOD /path' key returning { status, headers, body }; set content-type explicitly, there is no default.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: The in-memory store is for tests and local dev only; production uses the Postgres adapter in the deploy repo. Don't add persistence here.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: The partner portal parses invoicesJson output strictly: don't rename or reorder its fields (invoiceId, customerName, issuedAt, total) without telling the partner team.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: The monthly report's total row uses the default currency (EUR) even if invoices mix currencies. Mixed-currency months are rare; tracked in LL-198.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: formatDate uses the server's time zone; the production servers run in Europe/Paris, so dates in emails can differ from UTC by a day.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Fixtures are shared across test files; add new invoices at the end so existing index-based assertions keep working.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: index.js is the package's public API; the partner SDK imports from it by name. Removing or renaming an export is a breaking change.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: listInvoices sorts by issuedAt then id so pagination is stable. Keep the tie-break when adding filters.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: The monthly report test asserts on formatted money and breaks if the Node ICU data changes; pin Node 22 in CI.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Exports are pure functions over an invoice list; they don't read the store themselves. The router passes listInvoices(store).
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: Exports can be large: keep them as one string build for now, but don't add per-row awaits; a streaming version is planned.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: lib/ has no dependencies on the rest of src/ and is also published as @ledgerline/lib; keep it that way.
notes.author: claude-code
